description: Prebuilt IRS/FTB reference corpus (FTS5 + embeddinggemma-2 768-dim local embeddings, claude-opus-5 contextual summaries) + forms catalog. 10 docs / 527 blocks, tax year 2025.
_notes: GitHub Release asset (corpus-v2 tag). Embeddings are EmbeddingGemma 2 (ollama/embeddinggemma-2, stamped in ref_meta) so fresh clones running Ollama need no reembed; corpus-v1 shipped retired Voyage vectors. NOTE: repo is private — unauthenticated download 404s until the repo goes public; until then 'corpus fetch' falls back to CORPUS_SEED_PATH or 'gh release download corpus-v2'. Everyone downloads the full corpus; per-state packs are a future option if size demands it.
